build-type.name: ProteoWizard Publish Docker image
build-type.description: Tags container from master branch and pushes to DockerHub.

parameters.param:
/usr/bin/docker load -i pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses.tbz2
# The .NET msconvert prints no version: the container build labels the image with the one # in its installer's name. An image without the label is a C++ one, whose msconvert prints # "ProteoWizard release: <version> (<hash>)". version=$(/usr/bin/docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.version" }}' chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r') if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = "<no value>" ]; then /usr/bin/docker run --rm chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 mywine msconvert 2>&1 | grep "ProteoWizard release:" > VERSION version=$(sed -Ee "s/ProteoWizard release: ([0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+) \(([0-9a-z]+)\)/\1-\2/" VERSION | tr -d '\r') fi echo version: $version
# Push nothing without a version: an empty one makes every :$version reference invalid, # and the :latest pushes would still go through, leaving latest with no versioned tag. if [ -z "$version" ]; then echo "##teamcity[buildProblem description='Could not determine the ProteoWizard version of the image, so nothing was pushed']" exit 1 fi
/usr/bin/docker tag chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version /usr/bin/docker tag chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest /usr/bin/docker tag chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version /usr/bin/docker tag chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest
/usr/bin/docker push chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version /usr/bin/docker push chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 /usr/bin/docker push chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest /usr/bin/docker push proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version /usr/bin/docker push proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest
/usr/bin/docker rmi chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version \ chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 \ chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest \ proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:$version \ proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:latest
